requests.author: luissiviero
requests.body:
Two changes before the build:
1. plan.md step 9 (lines 88–89) and "Files that change" (line 35): bump `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` together with `plugin.json`. `tests/test_scaffold.py:47` asserts the two versions are equal, so bumping only `plugin.json` fails the suite. The version is the next free patch number when this merges (choice 184).
2. plan.md Proof list (lines 199–246): add the tests the Risks section promises at lines 101–103 (a plan edited after the merge base), 121–124 (`risk_list: ["tests"]` configured) and 133–135 (the runbook-file fixture).
Optional: `spec.md:2` and `intent.md:10` name 0.3.6 and 0.3.7; `spec.md:41` cites `description.py` lines that #199 moved.
